loss_weighting: official unmodified sum of four terms

preprocessing_adaptation.expression_units: anchor2048_log1p_per10000_v1; original J0 units remain fixed
preprocessing_adaptation.differs_from_paper: Official raw pipeline normalizes by whole-library totals; J0 uses fixed A2048 anchor denominator. Therefore this is an official-model reproduction on the shared J0 benchmark, not identical original-paper raw preprocessing.
preprocessing_adaptation.cell_selection: all observations supplied by the frozen interface per condition, up to256 cached cells, shared with other methods
preprocessing_adaptation.delta_p: mean supplied P_log1p minus full measured pooled E_log1p mean
preprocessing_adaptation.DE: two-sided asymptotic Mann-Whitney U, tie and continuity correction; BH per perturbation over tested genes
preprocessing_adaptation.tested_filter: linear P or E mean >0.05; native 5CPM numeric threshold transplanted to fixed J0 units; not claimed to be identical physical CPM
preprocessing_adaptation.untested: fold_change=0, fdr=1, lfc_true=NaN; delta_p retained for all output genes

inference.permitted_inputs: public frozen knowledge, target measured controls, active-fold training-source observations only
inference.learned_source_evidence: official pooled donor/context sufficient statistics; self pair excluded
inference.held_source_adaptation: During no_grad inference only, allow same-target source observations from all three active-fold training contexts, including their internal-held conditions, as permitted by common J0 interface. Aggregate with official evidence rules and training-fitted scales/clips.
inference.training_evidence: only4116 legal training conditions; no internal-held observations in gradients, negative banks, fitted grids, or evidence scales
inference.mean_readout: official argmax delta_p bin centre, then max(full target control mean+delta_p,0)

initialization.task_weights: fresh independently for every fold and seed

checkpoint_selection.criterion: maximize official binary_auprc with official equal-context aggregation

distribution.reason: The categorical delta_p head is a discretized mean shift, not a single-cell population distribution. No new control-pushforward adapter is invented.

reporting.native_metrics: all six official PIE metrics also retained
reporting.variance: average3seeds within fold, then mean and sample variance across5folds; seed variance separately
reporting.test_use: validation-selected frozen checkpoint once per run; existing benchmark is retrospective
